paragraphs: So Seder HaDorot cites from Kiddushin 30a; the text Hyman uses reads: “Rava said to Rav Natan bar Ami.”[^1][^2]

notes.text: The William Davidson digital text of Kiddushin 30a reads “Rava said to Rabbi Natan bar Ami.” Hyman’s heading gives an apparent extended patronymic; his explanation instead separates Rava as the speaker and fully writes Rav before Natan. Both the full title difference and Hyman’s proposed parsing are retained.

The whole Davidson Kiddushin 30a paragraph reads Rava speaking TO Rabbi Natan bar Ami. Hyman fully writes Rav Natan and reports an apparent extended patronymic in Seder HaDorot. His title and parsing are retained beside the digital Rabbi form; Seder HaDorot itself was not freshly collated here and no father-chain is created.
